title: I won't read LLM authored fiction
summary: A personal essay expressing the author's refusal to read fiction authored by Large Language Models, exploring themes of authenticity, human creativity, and the value of human artistic expression in literature.
problem_solved: Raises ethical and aesthetic questions about the role of AI in creative writing and reader authenticity expectations.
why_valuable: Contributes to the ongoing cultural debate about AI-generated content and what it means for human creativity and artistic consumption.
